name: Jalal al-Din al-Suyuti
bio: Jalal al-Din al-Suyuti was born in Cairo in 849 AH (1445 CE) and lost his father as a child. His family came from Asyut in Upper Egypt. A scholar of hadith, he wrote al-Itqan on the study of the Quran, a history of the caliphs and a biographical dictionary of linguists and grammarians. Al-Zirikli relates that at forty he withdrew to the island of al-Rawda on the Nile to write, declining gifts from rulers. He died in 911 AH (1505 CE).
